faq.a: University applicants whose programme asks for C1 and professionals in demanding roles often need German C1. Requirements differ, so confirm them with your university or employer.

faq.q: What does the Goethe-Zertifikat C1 exam test?
faq.a: The Goethe C1 exam is modular and tests long, demanding texts, fast native speech, structured writing on complex topics and fluent presentation and discussion.

faq.q: How is the German C1 course in Dehradun taught?
faq.a: Through reading, discussion and writing practice on real academic and professional topics, with detailed feedback from your trainer on style, register and structure.

faq.q: Is the C1 exam very different from B2?
faq.a: The four modules are the same, but the texts are longer and the tasks expect more precise, well-structured language and a wider range of expressions.

faq.q: Can I study German C1 online?
faq.a: Yes. German C1 classes run online and offline at our Race Course centre in Dehradun, including personalised sessions for focused exam preparation.
